source: Quoted from https://docs.wave.com/checkout and https://docs.wave.com/webhook, consulted 2026-10-14. Protocol data sent to the developer's code, not interface text.
missingAuth: Your request should include an HTTP auth header.
invalidAuth: Your HTTP auth header can't be processed.
unknownKey: The key you provided doesn't exist in our system.
sessionNotFound: You requested a checkout session by ID that we can't match to anything in our system. You should double-check that the ID corresponds to one that you've received in a response.
refundFailed: You tried to refund a checkout but the transaction couldn't be made. It's possible that the payment wasn't in a success state beforehand, the recipient account was blocked, or your wallet didn't have sufficient funds for the transaction.
